source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure of a neuron (PDF 27-28).

blocks.text: Neurons ki banawat mein bohat farq hota hai, lekin har neuron ke teen bunyadi hisse hain: cell body, dendrites aur axon.

Cell body neuron ka phaila hua hissa hai. Neuron ka nucleus aur us ke zyada tar organelles cell body mein hote hain. Cell body ke cytoplasm ki pehchan Nissl's granules hain. Yeh ribosomes aur rough endoplasmic reticulum ke guchhe hain.

Dendrites cell body se nikalne wale, membrane mein lipte hue (membrane-bounded) phailao hain. Dendrites doosre neurons ya doosre cells se maloomat lete hain, use nerve impulses mein badalte hain aur cell body ki taraf le jate hain. Cell body se impulses axon ke zariye door le jaye jate hain. Motor aur inter-neurons ek hi waqt mein bohat si jagahon se impulses lete hain, isi liye un ke dendrites bohat zyada shakhdar (branched) hote hain.

Axon cell body ka lamba, membrane mein lipta hua phailao hai. Yeh impulses ko cell body se door le jata hai. Neuron mein ek axon bhi ho sakta hai aur shakhdar axons bhi. Axon ke sire ko axon terminal kehte hain. Yeh kisi muscle cell, gland cell ya doosre neuron se mil kar us tak paigham pohancha sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Neuron: shakhdar dendrites cell body ke gird jis mein nucleus hai, aur lamba axon jis par Schwann cells hain aur jo shakhdar axon terminals par khatam hota hai. Teer myelinated axon ke aik hisse ki bari tasveer tak jata hai: axon, us ke gird lipti myelin sheath (charbi ka ghilaf), Schwann cell ka nucleus aur do Schwann cells ke darmiyan node of Ranvier.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Dendrites, Nucleus, Cell body, Axon, Schwann cell, Axon terminals; bari tasveer mein Node of Ranvier, Nucleus of Schwann cell, Myelin sheath, Axon.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure ko baayen se daayen parhein: shakhdar dendrites paigham lete hain, cell body (nucleus wala hissa) use sambhalti hai, aur lamba axon use aage axon terminals tak le jata hai. Bari tasveer mein dekhein ke Schwann cell axon ke gird lipat kar myelin sheath banata hai, aur do Schwann cells ke beech khaali jagah node of Ranvier hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Axon kaafi lamba ho sakta hai: aap ke paon ke muscles ko chalane wale axons ek meter se zyada lambe hain, aur zarafe (giraffe) mein khopri se pelvis tak jane wale axons taqreeban teen meter lambe hain!

Nervous system mein kuch khaas cells neurons ki madad (support) karte hain. In madadgar cells ko neuroglia ya glial cells kehte hain. Yeh neurons ko ghiza (nutrients) dete hain, fuzla (wastes) hatate hain aur immunity (bimari se hifazat) dete hain. Do aham glial cells Schwann cells aur oligodendrocytes hain. Yeh bohat se neurons ke axons ke gird lipte hote hain aur axons par myelin sheaths (membrane ki kai tahon wale ghilaf) banate hain. Schwann cells peripheral nervous system ke axons par myelin sheath banate hain. Oligodendrocytes central nervous system mein myelin sheath banate hain.

Myelin sheath ek insulating (bijli ko rokne wala) ghilaf hai. Yeh axon par nerve impulse ko tezi se chalne mein madad deta hai. Jin neurons ke axons par myelin sheath ho unhein myelinated, aur jin par yeh ghilaf na ho unhein non-myelinated kehte hain. CNS mein myelinated axons white matter banate hain, aur non-myelinated dendrites aur cell bodies grey matter banate hain. Peripheral nervous system mein myelinated aur non-myelinated dono axons ikatthe bandh kar nerves banate hain. Myelinated neurons mein myelin sheath har 1 se 2 mm ke baad chhoti khaali jagahon (non-myelinated hisson) se toot'ti hai. In khaali jagahon ko nodes of Ranvier kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Dimagh mein myelin kaun se cells banate hain, aur baazu ki nerve mein kaun se?
blocks.explanation: Dimagh (CNS) mein oligodendrocytes; baazu ki nerve (PNS) mein Schwann cells.

items: Neuron ke teen hisse: cell body (nucleus, Nissl's granules), dendrites (paigham cell body ki taraf) aur axon (paigham cell body se door, axon terminal tak).

Neuroglia neurons ki madad karte hain; Schwann cells (PNS) aur oligodendrocytes (CNS) myelin sheath banate hain; har 1 se 2 mm par nodes of Ranvier; CNS mein myelinated axons white matter aur cell bodies grey matter banate hain.
